spreadsheet, a PDF, a slide"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" deck, or a notebook. Claude Code reads PDFs and
notebooks natively; Codex has nothing. DSH Cowork c"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"loses that gap as an
out-of-tree plugin (no fork, no PR needed — the ecosystem path
CONTRIBUTING.md "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ap as an
out-of-tree plugin (no fork, no PR needed — the ecosystem path
CONTRIBUTING.md recommends)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Two ideas make "Cowork = READ + WRITE" coherent instead of two separate
tools:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"1. **Stable addresses.** `doc_read` returns *cell refs* for xlsx (`A1`, `C12`)
and *shape ids* for p"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ptx — `doc_write` consumes them. Line numbers cannot
address binary formats; addresses can.
2. **Bou"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"nded windows, explicit truncation.** Every read is capped
(pages / rows / slides / cells / bytes). S"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ilent truncation is the cardinal
sin: a `> Truncated:` notice always tells you the window was cut sh"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"t truncation is the cardinal
sin: a `> Truncated:` notice always tells you the window was cut short."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Packages"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Package | What it is |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| `packages/core` | Pure TS, zero DSH deps: sniff → extract → build, windowing, safety caps |
| `pac"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"kages/dsh` | **DSH bundle**: `doc_read` / `doc_write` tools (install with `dsh plugin add`) |
| `pac"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"kages/mcp` | **MCP server** over stdio — for Codex, Claude Code, any MCP client |
| `packages/cli` |"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" `doc-read` / `doc-write` binaries + `SKILL.md` (the `pi` harness adapter) |

checked before any cod"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ec expands bytes.
- **Macros**: `.xlsm` / `.docm` / `.pptm` (anything with `vbaProject.bin`) are
rej"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ected outright — Cowork never reads or writes macro formats.
- **Read-only mode**: in `read-only` sa"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"ndbox mode, `doc_write` is hard-blocked
while `doc_read` stays available.
- **Edit guards**: `doc_wr"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ite` edit refuses unless the file was read this
session (`expected_version`), and optionally fails o"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"n content change
(`expected_sha256`) — a hash-check on every edit.
- **No silent overwrite**: creati"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"ng over an existing file requires having read
it (DSH) or `force` (CLI/MCP).
- **Atomic writes**: te"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"mp file + rename, never a partial target.
- **Stale formulas**: edited xlsx sheets get cached formul"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"a results cleared so
Excel / LibreOffice recalculate on open (exceljs never recalculates).
- **Untru"},{"id":"p24s10","text":"sted input**: formulas, hidden sheets, and speaker notes are treated
as data, surfaced with the extr"},{"id":"p24s11","text":"action, never executed."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The DSH bundle routes reads through `ctx.fs` (bounded `readBytes`,
